title: Variable Paths
description: Adds that dirt and mud and stuff to grass paths. No need to place standalone blocks!
body:
**Are you too lazy to build additional blocks to make your paths better?**

**Are you too lazy to collect additional blocks to make your paths better?**

**Do you want to turn grass into gravel with a shovel?**

Don't you worry, because Variable Paths have got your back!

Just for $0.00, your paths will look like you are a Hardcore 1 000 000 Days YouTuber!

### Variable Paths

Variable Paths is a resource pack that turns your paths into these blocks randomly:
- Coarse Dirt
- Rooted Dirt
- Packed Mud
- Gravel

Upsides:
- You don't have to place or get the above blocks

Downsides:
- You don't have an option
- Paths are flat and unshadowy without real blocks
- Your friends still think you suck at building, unless they have this resource pack too

**⚠️ This resource pack will break on versions under 1.19 because Minecraft doesn't have the Packed Mud texture! ⚠️**

Variable Paths uses Minecraft textures to change paths, so it is fully resource pack compatible.
